passages.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
passages.title: Bhutan country report: Agro-ecological zones
passages.text: Bhutan's official country report groups farming environments by elevation: wet subtropical below about 600 m, humid subtropical about 600-1,200 m, dry subtropical 1,200-1,800 m, warm temperate 1,800-2,600 m, cool temperate 2,600-3,600 m, and alpine above 3,600 m.

passages.title: About Punakha Dzongkhag
passages.text: Punakha is known for rice, vegetables and fruit. The district profile identifies paddy, wheat, maize and mustard among its main crops.

passages.title: Integrated Agriculture and Livestock Census of Bhutan 2023
passages.text: The 2023 census reports paddy as Bhutan's most widely grown cereal and names Punakha among the highest cereal-producing dzongkhags. Major national crops include maize, mustard, pulses, chilli and mandarin.

passages.publisher: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
passages.title: Citrus Canker
passages.text: Citrus canker signs include raised brown lesions with water-soaked edges and a yellow halo on leaves, fruit or stems; older lesions can appear corky. Wind-driven rain and movement of contaminated plant material spread the bacterium. Suspected signs warrant plant-health reporting.

passages.publisher: University of California Statewide IPM Program
passages.title: Citrus Leafminer
passages.text: Citrus leafminer larvae create shallow serpentine mines in young leaves, causing curling and distortion. Leafminer injury can create entry points for bacterial canker, so the two problems may occur together.

passages.title: Soil Testing
passages.text: Soil-test fertilizer and lime recommendations depend on laboratory measurements. Lime requirement uses a buffer or exchangeable-acidity measurement in addition to water pH, and phosphorus and potassium interpretation depends on the laboratory extraction method and crop calibration.

passages.title: Calculating manure application rates
passages.text: A manure application rate requires the target crop's nutrient need and the manure's analyzed nutrient content. Applying enough manure for nitrogen can overapply phosphorus, so the nutrient basis must be explicit.

passages.title: Plant Protection Code for Large Cardamom
passages.text: Large-cardamom guidance emphasizes balanced shade, plant health and well-decomposed organic manure. Disease management should use clean planting material, field sanitation and locally approved plant-protection guidance.
